title: Two Sum

story.title: The Exact Change Market
story.text: A shopper walks down a row of price crates. Each time they pick up a crate, they ask the locker wall: "Has anyone stored the price I still need?" Lockers are labelled by price and hold the crate's index.
story.goal: Return the indices of the two crates whose prices add up to the target.

hints: For each number, the partner you need is target - nums[i].
Store what you've seen in a hash map.
